settings.heading: Every meal tells a story
settings.text: Casa Fresca is Sergio Landaverde’s kitchen. He grew up in El Salvador surrounded by the aromas of fresh pupusas, tamales and stews, and brought that love of cooking to the United States.

settings.label: The training
settings.title: Years in top restaurant kitchens
settings.text: Sergio worked as a career chef in high-end restaurants, from mastering knife work to perfecting complex dishes. That is where the precision comes from.

settings.label: The leap
settings.title: Something of his own
settings.text: He started Casa Fresca to blend that professional training with the soul of the food he grew up with, and to build a better life for his wife and three children.

settings.label: Today
settings.title: A family business, every week
settings.text: Meals made every week, coolers stocked around town, and catering for everything from rehearsal dinners to company dinners for 160.

settings.heading: From El Salvador, by way of fine-dining kitchens

settings.quote: “To deliver delicious, high-quality meals that nourish the body and soul.”

settings.title: Chef-crafted
settings.text: Restaurant-quality meals from a career chef, portioned to fuel your week.

settings.title: Part of the family
settings.text: “Sergio is a hard working, kind human being who treats all of his customers like family.” Adam Welcher, Google review

settings.heading: Proud to pitch in
settings.text: Casa Fresca was a Harvest Partner Sponsor of the 2026 Davidson Greenhouse Harvest Festival, September 26–27: a weekend of live music, local vendors, food and family fun.
